# T-3: Model lifecycle actions

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Add lifecycle action classes and attach declarative lifecycle behavior to flow definition nodes where simple lifecycle decisions are definition-derived.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Lifecycle actions are class instances with constructor validation.
- Lifecycle definitions cover status transitions, keep-in-progress behavior, metric increments, issue-log appends, side-effect execution, skip behavior, and hook escape hatches.
- Complex finalize execution behavior is represented by hook actions that call existing handler modules rather than declarative primitives.

## Implementation Notes
Keep primitive vocabulary small and use normal JavaScript handlers for git/filesystem/report side effects.

## Test Strategy
Spec-local unit tests instantiate lifecycle classes and assert invalid constructor inputs throw.
